editorial:
Imagine a family that is way too good at lying and stealing, then toss them into a quiet town in Scotland. You get to follow the Toussaints, a group of pro scammers who try to play the part of the most boring, perfect neighbors anyone has ever met. The vibe is super light and chaotic, as they try to keep their fake lives together while dealing with weird coworkers and a neighbor who seems to know a bit too much. It feels like a high-stakes game of hide-and-seek where one wrong word could send them all back to jail.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the family members and the funny gadgets they use to pull off their tricks. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the plot twists are a bit predictable. If you want something easy to watch that makes you laugh, you should definitely check this out. It looks stunning in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, the mysterious neighbor is revealed to be an undercover agent who was tracking them all along. Just when it looks like the family will be arrested, they use one last giant scam to trick the agent and the local police. They manage to steal the agent's evidence and vanish from Scotland in the middle of the night. The movie ends with them arriving in a new country, ready to start another fake life together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted comedies about criminals and family dynamics.
